fees.notes: AIMST does not publish tuition fees on its official website: programme pages list entry requirements/structure only and the International Students page lists programme durations and visa/accommodation costs but no tuition. Fees are provided on application/enquiry (choose@aimst.edu.my). Source: https://aimst.edu.my/international-students/ (checked 2026-09-18).

requirements.local: STPM CGPA 2.0 OR Matriculation/Foundation CGPA 2.5 OR UEC B6 x5 OR Diploma/Bachelor CGPA 2.5 OR Diploma in Nursing recognized by MNB OR STAM Jayyid 2.0. Must possess current PC/RON for nurses.
requirements.international: A-Level Grade C x3 CGPA 2.5 OR Foundation CGPA 2.5 OR STPM CGPA 2.0 OR Diploma in Nursing CGPA 2.5 + registered with Nursing Council + TPC from MNB + MUET Band 3.0 or IELTS 5.5.

program_name_zh: 护理学学士（荣誉学位）（远程教学）
